Name: Stop Flower Harvest
Author: blobleader
Description:
Current flowers in mod: Fairy Rose, Poppy, and Blue Jazz

If you want to access a menu, you have to install GMCM at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098

Make sure you install SMAPI first at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/ and follow the instructions there.

If you want to modify this mod for yourself, here's the github link: https://github.com/seichen/Stardew-Stop-Flower-Harvests
*In case you did not know, this will not actually modify the mod on this page

Downloads.Description: Fixed manifest.json to have the right version
